description.value:
You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class. These spells depend on your chosen giant heritage, as shown in the tables below. The spells count as sorcerer spells for you, but they don't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

Cloud Giant Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdFog Cloud, Silent Image, Invisibility, Warding Wind
5thGaseous Form, Major Image
7thGreater Invisibility, Hallucinatory Terrain
9thControl Winds, Seeming
Fire Giant Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdBurning Hands, Catapult, Enhance Ability, Heat Metal
5thElemental Weapon, Fireball
7thFabricate, Fire Shield
9thCreation, Flame Strike
Frost Giant Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdArmor of Agathys, Frost Fingers, Hold Person, Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
5thSleet Storm, Summon Warrior
7thFire Shield, Ice Storm
9thBigby's Hand, Cone of Cold
Hill Giant Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdHeroism, Longstrider, Earthbind, Protection from Poison
5thCreate Food and Water, Erupting Earth
7thLocate Creature, Stoneskin
9thDestructive Wave, Tree Stride
Stone Giant Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdId Insinuation, Sleep, Calm Emotions, Suggestion
5thEnemies Abound, Meld into Stone
7thStoneskin, Stone Shape
9thModify Memory, Wall of Stone
Storm Giant Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdIdentify, Witch Bolt, Detect Thoughts, Misty Step
5thClairvoyance, Lightning Bolt
7thDivination, Storm Sphere
9thScrying, Legend Lore
